reuse.reason: The official Models page is mounted through the marked @dsh-base/client-deepseek-provider fork; no official Gateway provider exists. This plugin contributes the independent operator-managed Gateway provider card via the public settings.models.provider-card slot. Its row, compact Details action and expanded editor hierarchy reuse the pinned official ModelsSection CSS classes; the Host/modelAccess seam supplies real availability and catalog. Anonymous Models reuses the same card with a minimal observable signed-out face containing only optional caller-supplied public model declarations; it never constructs the live controller or reads account state. No settings page or provider editor is copied.
gaps: Gateway is a product-specific provider with no official package; its slot card reuses the pinned official Models row/editor styles rather than a pure Host-only seam.
Gateway configuration is operator-managed and read-only; its expanded surface exposes status/authentication/catalog only, with no editable credential form.

User-approved UI adaptation (R1): the official credential-dot class/token is reused for platform authentication readiness; the green dot means platform auth is configured/available, not an API key or credential, and is absent for loading/error/unavailable/signed-out.

Anonymous state is explicit and localized as Sign in to view; public model declarations are labelled Models, never Available models. The immutable signed-out facade does not read the Host, install refresh listeners or upgrade into observed availability. The official row/details hierarchy and controlled disclosure behavior remain unchanged.
